release_notes: What four full financial years found. Four mock companies were run through the application for a complete year each: a café, a builder, an online retailer and a rental business, covering invoice and payments basis GST, monthly, two-monthly and six-monthly filing, exports, exempt rents, capital purchases, loans, refunds, bad debts and year-end reporting. The books were then audited independently - once by an external auditor, once as an Inland Revenue GST review - and the application was attacked with hostile inputs. The fixes below are what those exercises found. The GST working papers now match the GST101A return. …
